    p.product_code,
    pc.product_title,
    COUNT(*) AS n_cases,
    ROUND(SUM(p.weight)) AS est_visits,
    MIN(p.low_sample) AS low_sample

    SELECT 2025 AS year, product_1 AS product_code, weight, 0 AS low_sample FROM neiss_cases WHERE year = 2025 AND (product_1 IN (1401, 1422, 1431, 1439, 1448) OR product_2 IN (1401, 1422, 1431, 1439, 1448) OR product_3 IN (1401, 1422, 1431, 1439, 1448))
) p
JOIN product_codes pc ON pc.product_code = p.product_code
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY est_visits DESC
